headline: Names a Bremerton, Washington post office building after John Henry Turpin.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 602 Pacific Avenue in Bremerton, Washington, as the John Henry Turpin Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates. The summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020.
